Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
What is the Jaanch PreMarital Health CheckUp offered by Thyrocare?
The Jaanch PreMarital Health CheckUp by Thyrocare is a comprehensive diagnostic package designed for couples planning to get married. It helps assess overall health, detect hereditary or infectious diseases, and ensure better marital health.
Why should I opt for the Jaanch PreMarital Health CheckUp by Thyrocare?
This premarital health checkup by Thyrocare ensures transparency between partners regarding their health. It identifies potential health risks and promotes a healthy start to married life.
What tests are included in the Thyrocare Jaanch PreMarital Health CheckUp?
The package includes a wide range of tests, such as blood group typing, sexually transmitted infection screening, genetic disorder assessment, fertility tests, and other vital parameters.
How can I book the Jaanch PreMarital Health CheckUp with Thyrocare?
You can book the Jaanch PreMarital Health CheckUp online through our website. Thyrocare offers home sample collection, making the process easy and convenient.
Who should take the Jaanch PreMarital Health CheckUp?
This test is recommended for all individuals or couples preparing for marriage to assess their health, fertility, and potential genetic risks.
What are the benefits of Thyrocares PreMarital Health CheckUp?
Thyrocare’s premarital health package ensures early detection of genetic or infectious conditions, promoting a healthy marital relationship and better family planning.
How reliable are the test results from Thyrocare?
Thyrocare is a trusted diagnostic service provider with NABL and ISO certifications. The test results are accurate, reliable, and provided promptly.
What is the cost of the Jaanch PreMarital Health CheckUp by Thyrocare?
The cost of this package is affordable and varies based on offers and discounts. Visit our website or contact us for the latest pricing details.
How soon will I receive the reports for the Jaanch PreMarital Health CheckUp?
You will receive a detailed report via email within 24-48 hours of sample collection.
Are there any special preparations required for this test?
Some tests in the Jaanch PreMarital Health CheckUp may require fasting. Detailed instructions will be shared during the booking process.
